import hashlib, pathlib, tarfile, tempfile
archive=pathlib.Path('harness/frodock.tar.gz')
if hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!='91b9aeff747346046c7f8c4c92fa5749c9f082d8122ee9d2d4769855d35368f4':
    raise RuntimeError('Archive checksum mismatch')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='frodock-extraction-') as temporary:
    root=pathlib.Path(temporary)
    with tarfile.open(archive) as t:
        archive_root=(root/'frodock3_linux64').resolve()
        for m in t.getmembers():
            parts=pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).parts
            if (not parts or parts[0]!='frodock3_linux64' or '..' in parts
                    or m.name.startswith('/') or not (m.isfile() or m.isdir() or m.issym())):
                raise RuntimeError('Unsafe FroDock archive member: '+m.name)
            destination=(root/m.name).resolve()
            if destination!=archive_root and archive_root not in destination.parents:
                raise RuntimeError('FroDock archive member escapes extraction root: '+m.name)
            if m.issym():
                target=(root/m.name).parent.joinpath(m.linkname).resolve()
                if pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.linkname).is_absolute() or (target!=archive_root and archive_root not in target.parents):
                    raise RuntimeError('Unsafe FroDock archive link: '+m.name)
        t.extractall(root)
    for name in ('tclap','cmdl'):
        link=archive_root/'includes'/name
        if not link.is_symlink() or not link.is_dir() or link.resolve()!=archive_root/'src'/name:
            raise RuntimeError('Invalid extracted include link: '+name)
    soap=archive_root/'bin/soap.bin'
    if hashlib.sha256(soap.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!='791f31ec8ef1ef1466092b425638e926755519c9626f5678ca675ef6c76234fc':
